headline: India Glycols Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - India Glycols Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Apportionment of Cost of Acquisition of Equity Shares of India GlycolsLimited ( Demerged Company / the Company ), Ennature Bio PharmaLimited ( Resulting Company 1 ) and…
detail: Updates - India Glycols Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Apportionment of Cost of Acquisition of Equity Shares of India GlycolsLimited ( Demerged Company / the Company ), Ennature Bio PharmaLimited ( Resulting Company 1 ) and IGL Spirits Limited ( ResultingCompany 2 ) pursuant to Scheme of Arrangement amongst theCompany, Resulting Company 1 and Resulting Company 2 and theirrespective shareholders ( Scheme / Scheme of Arrangement )'.
